question.prompt: What web entry point should runnable browser tests start from for the add-task flow?

options.label: Use placeholder
options.detail: Author later web tests with {{start_url}} until an environment URL is supplied.

options.label: Provide URL
options.detail: Give a concrete URL or variable name for the app entry point.

options.label: Defer web runnability
options.detail: Accept that browser tests cannot run yet because no entry URL is defined.

content.risk_rationale: Without a start URL, the later web tests for this use case cannot be executed even though the feature itself is otherwise observable on a browser surface.

question.prompt: What should happen if Enter is pressed with an empty or whitespace-only task title?

options.label: Out of scope
options.detail: Do not assert any blank-title behavior until a source defines it.

options.label: Reject blank title
options.detail: Treat blank or whitespace-only submission as blocked validation behavior.

options.label: Create blank task
options.detail: Treat blank or whitespace-only input as a valid created task title.

content.risk_rationale: Blank-input behavior changes the negative-path scenarios and test oracles, and the PRD line for adding a task does not define it.

question.prompt: Are there any stated limits or formatting rules for a task title, such as maximum length or forbidden characters?

options.label: No rule sourced
options.detail: Do not assert length or character validation until a source states it.

options.label: Provide rule
options.detail: Supply a source or value for the title limits or format rules.

options.label: Assume free-form
options.detail: Treat any short user-entered text as acceptable for this use case.

content.risk_rationale: Length and format rules determine whether boundary and invalid-input scenarios exist; no such rule appears anywhere in the current PRD text.

content.text: When the user presses Enter after typing a task title, the todo list gains exactly one additional task.

expected_answer.baseline: number of tasks visible in the todo list before pressing Enter

content.text: After the user presses Enter on a typed task title, the todo list contains a task whose visible title matches the typed title.

expected_answer.operand: a todo-list item whose visible title equals the title typed before pressing Enter

judgements.rationale: [risk_factors] Applied user-reach because adding a task is the core creation path for all users of the todo list. Did not apply money, auth, or data-loss because the cited behavior describes ordinary creation with no payment flow, access gate, or destructive side effect. Did not apply change-frequency because the current source gives no signal that the Enter-submission rule is especially volatile.

[risk_factors] Applied user-reach because users must be able to see the task they just created in the list for the feature to be usable. Did not apply money, auth, or data-loss because the cited behavior stays within ordinary visible task creation. Did not apply change-frequency because the current source does not indicate unstable display rules for the created item.
